violations.text: Sour cream was observed held at 55 degrees Fahrenheit stored on the side of the prep unit. Staff notified to keep all foods in the hotel pans or at the bottom of the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods placed on the side of the unit less than 3 hours prior to inspection and moved to refrigeration to properly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Steak and pico de gallo was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep and covered. Proper cooling methods reviewed with staff at the time of inspection. Foods moved to shallow pans and uncovered. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as salsa and veggies) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 02/10/2025

The reach-in cooler was observed to be in poor repair (not holding temperatures below 41 degrees Fahrenheit). Equipment must be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2024
